description: A man in a bucket hat rides a yellow bicycle down a tree-lined park road. An Australian shepherd rides in a wooden crate mounted on the handlebars and a corgi sits on top of his backpack. A police car pulls alongside and a smiling female officer walks over, laughing, and bends down to stroke the dog in the crate while a second officer chats from the car window. Everyone is grinning; then the man pedals away down the shady road.
transcript: Goso. How are you, buddy? You know his name. That's Goso. Have a good day, guys. Nice meeting you. Let's go, boys.
